user.description: Twilight is configured via the sidebar panel — this entry only anchors devices for optional button/switch entities and requires no setup.

trigger_input.name: Trigger Input
trigger_input.description: Triggers a button-type input manually (click or toggle) for a given area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: The area ID containing the input.

input_id.name: Input ID
input_id.description: The ID or name of the button input to trigger.

active.name: Active State
active.description: For toggle buttons, sets whether the input state should be active (true) or inactive (false).
